targetTexts.1: These were the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun,
targetTexts.2: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
targetTexts.3: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, and Shelah. These three were born to him by Bath-shua the Canaanite. Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the sight of the LORD. So the LORD put him to death.
targetTexts.4: Tamar, Judah’s daughter-in-law, bore to him Perez and Zerah. Judah had five sons in all.
targetTexts.5: The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.
targetTexts.6: The sons of Zerah: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Dara—five in all.
targetTexts.7: The son of Carmi: Achar, who brought trouble upon Israel by violating the ban on devoted things.
targetTexts.9: The sons who were born to Hezron: Jerahmeel, Ram, and Caleb.
targetTexts.10: Ram was the father of Amminadab, and Amminadab was the father of Nahshon, a leader of the descendants of Judah.
targetTexts.11: Nahshon was the father of Salmon, and Salmon was the father of Boaz.
targetTexts.12: Boaz was the father of Obed, and Obed was the father of Jesse.
targetTexts.13: Jesse was the father of Eliab his firstborn; Abinadab was born second, Shimea third,
targetTexts.16: Their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. And the three sons of Zeruiah were Abishai, Joab, and Asahel.
targetTexts.17: Abigail was the mother of Amasa, whose father was Jether the Ishmaelite.
targetTexts.18: Caleb son of Hezron had children by his wife Azubah and by Jerioth. These were the sons of Azubah: Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.
targetTexts.19: When Azubah died, Caleb married Ephrath, who bore to him Hur.
targetTexts.20: Hur was the father of Uri, and Uri was the father of Bezalel.
targetTexts.21: Later, Hezron slept with the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead. He had married her when he was sixty years old, and she bore to him Segub.
targetTexts.22: Segub was the father of Jair, who had twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead.
targetTexts.23: But Geshur and Aram captured Havvoth-jair, along with Kenath and its sixty surrounding villages. All these were descendants of Machir the father of Gilead.
targetTexts.24: After Hezron died in Caleb-ephrathah, his wife Abijah bore to him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.
targetTexts.25: The sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron: Ram his firstborn, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.
targetTexts.26: Jerahmeel had another wife named Atarah, who was the mother of Onam.
targetTexts.27: The sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel: Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.
targetTexts.28: The sons of Onam: Shammai and Jada. The sons of Shammai: Nadab and Abishur.
targetTexts.29: Abishur’s wife was named Abihail, and she bore to him Ahban and Molid.
targetTexts.30: The sons of Nadab: Seled and Appaim. Seled died without children.
targetTexts.31: The son of Appaim: Ishi. The son of Ishi: Sheshan. The son of Sheshan: Ahlai.
targetTexts.32: The sons of Jada the brother of Shammai: Jether and Jonathan. Jether died without children.
targetTexts.33: The sons of Jonathan: Peleth and Zaza. These were the descendants of Jerahmeel.
targetTexts.34: Sheshan had no sons, but only daughters. He also had an Egyptian servant named Jarha.
targetTexts.35: Sheshan gave his daughter in marriage to his servant Jarha, and she bore to him Attai.
targetTexts.36: Attai was the father of Nathan, Nathan was the father of Zabad,
targetTexts.37: Zabad was the father of Ephlal, Ephlal was the father of Obed,
targetTexts.38: Obed was the father of Jehu, Jehu was the father of Azariah,
targetTexts.39: Azariah was the father of Helez, Helez was the father of Elasah,
targetTexts.40: Elasah was the father of Sismai, Sismai was the father of Shallum,
targetTexts.41: Shallum was the father of Jekamiah, and Jekamiah was the father of Elishama.
targetTexts.42: The sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel: Mesha his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph, and Mareshah his second son, who was the father of Hebron.
targetTexts.43: The sons of Hebron: Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.
targetTexts.44: Shema was the father of Raham the father of Jorkeam, and Rekem was the father of Shammai.
targetTexts.45: The son of Shammai was Maon, and Maon was the father of Beth-zur.
targetTexts.46: Caleb’s concubine Ephah was the mother of Haran, Moza, and Gazez. Haran was the father of Gazez.
targetTexts.47: The sons of Jahdai: Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph.
targetTexts.48: Caleb’s concubine Maacah was the mother of Sheber and Tirhanah.
targetTexts.49: She was also the mother of Shaaph father of Madmannah, and of Sheva father of Machbenah and Gibea. Caleb’s daughter was Acsah.
targetTexts.50: These were the descendants of Caleb. The sons of Hur the firstborn of Ephrathah: Shobal the father of Kiriath-jearim,
targetTexts.51: Salma the father of Bethlehem, and Hareph the father of Beth-gader.
targetTexts.52: These were the descendants of Shobal the father of Kiriath-jearim: Haroeh, half the Manahathites,
targetTexts.53: and the clans of Kiriath-jearim—the Ithrites, Puthites, Shumathites, and Mishraites. From these descended the Zorathites and Eshtaolites.
targetTexts.54: The descendants of Salma: Bethlehem, the Netophathites, Atroth-beth-joab, half the Manahathites, the Zorites,
targetTexts.55: and the clans of the scribes who lived at Jabez—the Tirathites, Shimeathites, and Sucathites. These are the Kenites who came from Hammath, the father of the house of Rechab.
